The best UK bank account for everyday spending depends on whether you want cashback on card purchases, cashback on household bills, or smart budgeting tools.

For most people looking purely at everyday debit card spending, Chase UK is the top choice because it offers ongoing cashback with no monthly fee. However, several strong alternatives win depending on how you manage your money:   
Money To The Masses

Account	Monthly Fee	Everyday Spending Perks	Key Extras & Trade-offs	Best For
Chase UK Current Account	£0	Cashback on eligible everyday debit card spending	Fee-free overseas spending, 5% AER round-up savings pot, and strong app budgeting. No overdraft or physical branches.	Everyday card spending & budgeting
Zopa Biscuit	£0	3% cashback on household bills + 1% in-credit interest	Fee-free overseas card use and easy-access savings pots. App-only with no overdraft facility.	Household bills & earning balance interest
Santander Edge	£3	1% cashback on eligible bills (up to £10/month)	Access to a 6.00% AER linked saver (up to £4,000) and fee-free foreign card spending. Requires £500/month pay-in and 2 Direct Debits.	All-round bills & savings
Starling Bank	£0	None (0% cashback)	Market-leading budgeting Spaces, instant spending notifications, fee-free overseas spending/ATM withdrawals, and 24/7 UK support.	App-based budgeting & travel
First Direct 1st Account	£0	None (0% cashback)	Top-rated UK customer service, £250 interest-free overdraft, fee-free overseas card spending, and a 7.00% regular saver.	Customer service & overdraft buffer
How to Choose

If you spend heavily on your debit card: Go with Chase UK. Because it is a separate app-based account with no overdraft, many people keep their main high-street bank for salary and Direct Debits, and transfer a weekly or monthly spending allowance to Chase to earn cashback.

If your main outgoing is household bills: Zopa Biscuit (fee-free) or Santander Edge (£3/month) will usually earn you more back on council tax, energy, and broadband Direct Debits than card cashback would.

If you want upfront switching cash: If you are willing to use the Current Account Switch Service (CASS) to move an existing account, Barclays (up to £300), Santander (£240), and First Direct (£210) are currently offering substantial cash bonuses.

Note: All banks listed above are UK-regulated and protect deposits up to £120,000 under the Financial Services Compensation Scheme (FSCS).
